tasks.title: Start Server (dev)
tasks.description: Start the paste HTTP server manually for dev/debugging. Auto-started by pi extension normally.

tasks.title: Stop Server
tasks.description: Kill the paste server process on port 9876.
tasks.command: kill $(lsof -ti:9876) 2>/dev/null || echo 'No server running on port 9876'

tasks.title: Restart Server
tasks.description: Stop then start the paste server.

tasks.title: Server Status
tasks.description: Check if the paste server is running and responding.

tasks.title: Link Plugin
tasks.description: Symlink this plugin into ~/.pi-web/plugins/ for local dev. Hard-reload the browser tab after.

tasks.title: Relink (unlink + link)
tasks.description: Remove then re-create the symlink — useful after switching branches.
tasks.command: npm run dev:unlink; npm run dev:link

tasks.title: Install from npm
tasks.description: Install the published public package globally and symlink it into pi-web plugins.

tasks.title: Check Symlink
tasks.description: Verify the plugin symlink exists and the server is accessible.
tasks.command: ls -la ~/.pi-web/plugins/screenshot-paste 2>/dev/null && curl -s http://localhost:9876/health || echo 'Plugin or server not found'
